subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should this PR's secure MagicDNS/Tailscale Serve onboarding chooser be rebased into the current iOS onboarding flow, or should the current onboarding refresh and one-step pairing work supersede it?
rationale: The branch is useful and proof-backed, but current main has overlapping onboarding and mobile pairing changes, so automation cannot choose the final UX/security direction or conflict resolution safely.

options.title: Sponsor rebase and repair
options.body: Keep the secure Tailscale/MagicDNS chooser, rebase it onto current onboarding, and fix the branded typography issue before merge.

options.title: Narrow to auth-copy/security tests
options.body: Drop the competing chooser UI and preserve only the password-missing auth copy or raw-IP security tests if maintainers want those smaller pieces.

options.title: Supersede with current pairing work
options.body: Close this branch once maintainers decide the merged onboarding refresh plus open one-step pairing PRs are the canonical path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor rebase and repair
recommendation.body: Keep the secure Tailscale/MagicDNS chooser, rebase it onto current onboarding, and fix the branded typography issue before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent mobile Tailnet route and gateway auth work makes this the best available owner for the UX/security direction choice.
